commands.name: ai.style
commands.description: Style transfer (P61 neural filter, on device): a fast neural style network repaints the layer in one style (udnie: Picabia, 1913; BSD-3-Clause, download_model style-udnie, person-only). Works at edge px on the long side, then scales to the canvas. Writes a new "Style: Udnie (edited)" layer above the source.

layerId.description: Layer id from get_state; default the active layer.

edge.description: Working long edge in px (default 1024); smaller gives larger strokes.

revision.description: Document revision this call was planned against; stale values return status 'stale'.
